name: wg-portal
description: WireGuard Portal is a web-based management UI for WireGuard servers. It creates and manages interfaces and peers with QR codes, expiry, user authentication, a REST API and Prometheus metrics, all from a single Go binary.

notes.text: Change the default admin password immediately after first login. Create a WireGuard interface in the UI; interfaces listen from UDP 51820, which must be forwarded on your router.
Needs a privileged container because the portal manages WireGuard through netlink. It deliberately does not create iptables or nftables rules — set those up separately if you need NAT.
Configuration is read from /opt/wgportal.env and the SQLite database lives in /opt/wgportal-data; both survive updates.
